 89:14: the "Three in One" presumably refers to the Trinity in the Christian

 go.41, 45: Yeats departs from the usual Christian tradition, in which the arch-
angel Gabriel sounds the trumpet which heralds the Last Judgment and the
archangel Michael is the warrior angel, the conqueror of Satan. Yeats also
noted that "Gabriel is the angel of the Moon in the Cabbala and might, I
considered, command the waters at a pinch."
